answer: Reaching the gale of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. A shale of per-task receipts records who did what, and the juniper of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, reset on any identity-link attempt. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
